scenario: When a new Zendesk ticket arrives from a requester whose organization is tagged Enterprise in Salesforce, raise its priority to Urgent, assign it to the named account's support pod, and post a heads-up in the #enterprise-support Slack channel with the account owner mentioned.

When a Freshdesk ticket crosses 80% of its first-response SLA without an agent reply, reassign it to the shift lead, add an internal note with the remaining time, and log the near-breach in the SLA tracking Google Sheet.

When a customer email requesting a refund is converted to a ticket, look up the order in the Shopify-exported orders sheet, and if the amount is under the auto-approve threshold issue a QuickBooks credit memo and reply to the customer; otherwise route it to the finance approver in Slack.

When a helpdesk ticket is tagged return_requested, check the purchase date against the return window in the policy sheet, and if eligible create an RMA row in the returns tracker, email the customer return instructions, and set the ticket to Pending.

When an agent tags a Zendesk ticket as confirmed_bug, create a Jira issue in the correct engineering project with the reproduction steps, link the Jira key back on the ticket, and notify the product area's triage channel in Slack.
rule_hooks: product area to Jira project mapping

scenario: When a Jira bug linked to support tickets moves to Done, find all linked Zendesk tickets, reply to each requester that the fix has shipped with the release version, and mark them Solved.
rule_hooks: Jira status to ticket status mapping

scenario: When a CSAT survey response of 1 or 2 stars is recorded in Intercom, reopen the conversation, assign it to the team lead of the agent who handled it, and add a row to the detractor review sheet with the comment and agent name.

When a ticket containing a cancellation request comes in from a customer with ARR above a set amount in HubSpot, create a retention task for the account's CSM, set the HubSpot deal stage to At Risk, and hold the ticket for 24 hours before processing.

When the status page is set to Major Outage for a component, tag all open tickets mentioning that component with the incident ID, post a macro reply acknowledging the outage, and update the incident tracker sheet with the affected ticket count.
rule_hooks: component keyword list and incident ID

scenario: When an incident in the incident tracker sheet is marked Resolved, send a resolution message to every ticket tagged with that incident ID, solve them, and email the summary to affected enterprise accounts' CSMs.

When an enterprise customer files a ticket claiming an SLA uptime credit, read the month's downtime minutes from the uptime log sheet, compute the credit from the contract's credit schedule, create a draft credit note in Xero, and reply with the credit amount for agent review.

When a Stripe dispute notification email arrives in the billing inbox, find the customer's support history in Freshdesk, create a high-priority ticket for the billing team with the evidence deadline, and add the dispute to the chargebacks sheet.

When a ticket reports being charged twice, check the QuickBooks payments for two identical charges within 24 hours, and if found issue a refund for one, add an internal note with both transaction IDs, and reply to the customer confirming.

When an agent tags a solved ticket with kb_gap, create a draft article task in the Notion knowledge backlog with the question and resolution, assign it to the docs owner for that product area, and notify them in Slack.
rule_hooks: product area to docs owner mapping

scenario: When a customer reply on a ticket says a linked help center article is wrong, flag the article in the Zendesk Guide review list, create a Asana task for the article owner with the ticket excerpt, and set a review due date by article traffic tier.
rule_hooks: article review SLA by traffic tier

scenario: When a new ticket includes legal threats or words like 'lawyer' or 'BBB', escalate it to the escalations queue, assign it to a senior agent, add the legal_risk tag, and alert the support manager by email.

When a public complaint mentioning the company handle is logged by the social listening tool into a Google Sheet, create a Zendesk ticket matched to the customer by email or handle, set the social channel field, and post the link in #social-care.

When a ticket arrives from an account whose HubSpot onboarding stage is still In Progress, route it to the onboarding specialist named on the account rather than general support, and log a touchpoint on the HubSpot company timeline.

When a warranty claim form submission arrives, look up the serial number in the device registry sheet, check it against the warranty term for that model, and either open a replacement order ticket for the fulfillment team or reply with the out-of-warranty repair quote.

When a customer reports a damaged delivery with photos attached, verify the order in the orders sheet, create a reshipment request in the fulfillment Trello board, file a carrier claim row in the claims sheet, and reply with the new tracking ETA.
rule_hooks: reship eligibility and carrier claim rules

scenario: When a ticket includes a phone callback request, find the next open slot on the tier-2 team's Google Calendar within business hours for the customer's timezone, book the call, and reply to the customer with the time and dial-in.

When a ticket is set to Priority P1 for an enterprise customer, create a Zoom meeting for an escalation call, invite the account's CSM, the on-call engineer from the on-call sheet, and the customer contact, and post the link on the ticket.

When a new Intercom conversation is detected in a non-English language, assign it to the team covering that language per the language coverage sheet, add a language tag, and send the auto-acknowledgement in that language.

When an agent's out-of-office event starts on their Google Calendar, reassign their open and pending Freshdesk tickets to their designated backup, add an internal note on each, and notify the backup in Slack with the ticket list.

When a ticket solved within the last 7 days is reopened by the customer for the same issue, tag it reopened_quality, assign it back to the original agent with a priority bump, and add a row to the weekly QA review sheet.
rule_hooks: reopen window and QA sampling rules

scenario: When a ticket is classified as a GDPR or CCPA data deletion request, create a request record in the privacy log sheet with the statutory due date, open a task for the privacy officer in Asana, and send the customer the identity verification email.

When an email to support reports a suspected security vulnerability or account compromise, move it to the restricted security queue, strip it from public views, page the security on-call via Slack, and send the reporter the responsible-disclosure acknowledgement.

When a customer asks support to downgrade their plan, look up the current subscription and renewal date in the billing sheet, compute the prorated credit per the billing policy, update the plan in HubSpot, and reply with the effective date and credit amount.

When a ticket asks for a copy of an invoice, find the matching invoice in Xero by customer and month, email the PDF link to the requester only if they are a listed billing contact, and otherwise reply asking for authorization from the account admin.

When a ticket is opened by an account whose Salesforce renewal date is within 60 days and ticket volume this quarter exceeds the health threshold, create a Salesforce task for the account executive and add a note to the account health sheet.

When a high-value replacement is approved on a ticket, send the customer a DocuSign return-and-replacement authorization form, and when it is signed, update the ticket with the envelope ID and move the RMA to Approved in the returns sheet.

When an agent tags a ticket feature_request, match it to an existing row in the product feedback sheet by feature name and increment its vote count with the account's ARR, or add a new row, and reply to the customer that it was logged.

When a ticket in the general queue remains unassigned for more than the queue's aging limit, assign it via round-robin to an on-shift agent from the shift roster sheet and post the reassignment in the team's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: queue aging limits and shift roster

scenario: When a ticket has been in Pending awaiting customer reply for the configured number of days, send a final reminder, and if there is still no reply after the grace period, set it to Solved with the abandoned tag and log it in the weekly metrics sheet.

When a ticket comes from a domain belonging to a reseller in the partner directory sheet, route it to the partner support queue, CC the partner manager listed for that reseller, and set the partner organization field.

When a long-tenured customer's ticket is resolved after a service failure, check their tenure and lifetime spend in HubSpot, apply the goodwill credit amount from the goodwill matrix in QuickBooks, and add the credit details to the ticket's closing reply.
rule_hooks: goodwill credit matrix by tenure and spend

scenario: When the support ops lead updates a policy row in the support policies sheet, update the corresponding Zendesk macro text, post a change announcement in #support-team with the old and new wording, and add the change to the policy changelog doc.

When a new ticket arrives from a requester who already has an open ticket with a similar subject in the last 48 hours, merge it into the existing ticket, notify the assigned agent, and send the customer a message referencing the original ticket number.

When a ticket is escalated to Tier 3, compile the customer's account details from Salesforce and the ticket timeline, email a summary to the VP of Support, and add the escalation to the monthly escalations report sheet.

When a customer reports an order not received, check the carrier tracking status in the shipments sheet, and if the delivery date exceeds the lost-package threshold, issue a refund or reship per the customer's choice, update the order record, and close the ticket with the resolution.

A customer emails asking to change the delivery address on a recent order; the agent looks up the order's fulfillment status in the orders sheet, updates the address if it hasn't shipped, posts the change to the warehouse Slack channel, and replies to the customer.

A Zendesk ticket requests cancellation of an order; the agent checks the order timestamp and status, cancels and voids payment if inside the cancellation window, otherwise converts the request to a return, and updates the ticket.

A customer requests a size or color exchange; the agent checks the inventory sheet for the replacement SKU, creates an exchange order and return authorization if in stock or offers a refund if not, and replies with next steps.
rule_hooks: stock levels, exchange eligibility by product category

scenario: Operations marks a SKU as backordered in the inventory sheet with a new ETA; the agent finds open orders and tickets for that SKU, emails affected customers with the revised date and a cancel option, and tags the tickets.
rule_hooks: backorder ETA, delay threshold for cancel offer

scenario: A customer emails a competitor's lower price for an item they bought last week; the agent checks the price-match policy sheet for approved retailers and the purchase date, issues the difference as a partial refund if eligible, and logs it in the ticket.

A ticket reports a promo code was rejected at checkout; the agent checks the code's terms and expiry in the promotions sheet and the order total, applies a manual post-purchase credit if the customer qualified, and replies with the outcome.
rule_hooks: promo terms, minimum spend, expiry date

scenario: A business customer emails a sales-tax exemption certificate; the agent marks the customer tax-exempt in QuickBooks, credits tax charged on open invoices issued after the certificate's effective date, and confirms by email.
rule_hooks: certificate effective date, state exemption validity

scenario: A Stripe payment-failure alert opens a ticket; the agent checks the account's failed attempts and plan, sends the customer a card-update link, sets the account to grace-period status in the CRM, and notifies the account owner if the account is high-value.
rule_hooks: dunning grace period, retry count, account tier

scenario: A user who lost their 2FA device asks to be unlocked; the agent compares the details they provide against the CRM contact record, resets 2FA and unlocks the account only if the required identity fields match, and otherwise requests more proof.
rule_hooks: identity verification checklist, required matching fields

scenario: A customer reports that their account owner left the company and asks to transfer ownership; the agent checks that the requester is a listed admin with an email on the company domain, updates the owner in the admin system and CRM, and notifies both the old and new owners.
rule_hooks: authorized admin list, domain match rule

scenario: A voicemail transcription email arrives from the phone system; the agent matches the caller's number to a CRM contact, creates a helpdesk ticket with the transcript and the contact's SLA tier, and schedules a callback task for the assigned agent.
rule_hooks: phone-to-contact lookup, callback SLA by tier

scenario: An agent moves a ticket to the Tier 2 queue; the agent checks that the mandatory escalation fields (repro steps, account ID, logs attached) are filled, routes the ticket to the correct Tier 2 group if they are, or bounces it back with a list of missing items.

Support leadership adds a public-holiday closure to the team calendar; the agent updates the helpdesk business-hours schedule, enables the holiday auto-reply for that date range, and posts the coverage plan in the support Slack channel.
rule_hooks: regional holiday calendar, on-call coverage roster

scenario: A new support hire appears in the HR onboarding sheet; the agent creates their Freshdesk agent seat with the role and groups for their team, adds them to the right Slack channels, and books their shadowing sessions on the calendar.
rule_hooks: role-to-group permission matrix, seat license count

scenario: An agent posts a shift-swap request in Slack; the agent checks the rota sheet to confirm the swap keeps every hour above minimum staffing and the covering agent has the required skills, updates the rota and calendars if it does, and pings the team lead.
rule_hooks: minimum staffing per hour, skill coverage requirements

scenario: A QA reviewer logs a ticket scorecard below threshold in the QA sheet; the agent checks the agent's recent scores, books a coaching session with their team lead if it is a repeat low score, and notifies the agent with the reviewer's notes.

A customer submits a 5-star CSAT rating on a solved ticket; the agent checks the contact hasn't been asked for a review recently and has no open issues, sends a review-site invitation email, and logs the ask in HubSpot.

Quality posts a recall notice listing affected lot numbers; the agent matches orders containing those lots, creates a recall ticket for each affected customer with remedy instructions, and sends a summary count to the compliance Slack channel.
rule_hooks: affected lot/serial ranges, recall remedy by product

scenario: A ticket mentions that a product caused an injury or property damage; the agent tags it for legal hold, removes it from standard macros and auto-close, notifies the legal and product-safety team, and sends the customer a holding response.
rule_hooks: safety keyword criteria, legal-hold handling policy

scenario: A customer explicitly files a formal complaint; the agent logs it in the complaints register with the statutory response deadline, assigns a complaint owner, sends the required acknowledgment letter, and sets a calendar reminder before the deadline.

A family member emails to report that an account holder has died; the agent checks the bereavement policy for required documents, pauses billing and marketing for the account, and replies with condolences and the document request.
rule_hooks: bereavement documentation requirements, billing pause rules

scenario: An email from a police department requests customer records; the agent logs the request in the legal-request tracker, forwards it to legal without disclosing any data, and sends the requester the standard acknowledgment pointing to the legal process.

A customer replies asking to move their on-site installation appointment; the agent checks the technician's calendar and the reschedule policy, books the nearest open slot, updates the work-order ticket, and notifies the technician and customer.
rule_hooks: reschedule notice period, technician territory and availability

scenario: The warehouse logs an inspection grade for a returned item in the RMA sheet; the agent applies the disposition rules to issue a full refund, partial refund with a restocking fee, or rejection, updates the ticket, and emails the customer the result.
rule_hooks: condition grade to refund-percentage table, restocking fee

scenario: A customer says their gift card balance is lower than expected; the agent pulls the card's transaction ledger, reinstates the balance if an unrecorded or erroneous charge is found, and replies with the transaction history.
rule_hooks: gift card ledger, reinstatement authorization limit

scenario: A subscriber asks to pause their plan for a few months; the agent checks pause eligibility and the maximum pause length for their plan, schedules the pause and resume dates in billing, and confirms the dates to the customer.

A trial user asks for more time to evaluate; the agent checks their usage and any prior extensions in the CRM, extends the trial if they qualify, notifies the assigned sales rep in Slack, and replies to the user.

Engineering posts a workaround for a known issue in the #known-issues Slack channel; the agent finds open tickets tagged with that issue, adds the workaround as an internal note, sends customers the workaround macro, and sets the tickets to pending.
rule_hooks: issue tag mapping, ticket status eligibility

scenario: An agent marks an incoming ticket as spam; the agent checks whether the sender domain belongs to any customer account, adds the sender to the helpdesk blocklist if it doesn't, and deletes other open spam tickets from the same sender.

A Salesforce opportunity closes for a Premium Support add-on; the agent updates the organization's SLA policy and priority routing in Zendesk, assigns the named technical account manager, and sends the customer the premium support welcome email.
rule_hooks: support plan to SLA policy map, TAM assignment roster

scenario: A ticket arrives from an organization whose support contract end date has passed; the agent confirms the lapse in the CRM, applies the basic-tier SLA and tags the ticket, notifies the renewal owner, and tells the customer what coverage applies.
rule_hooks: contract end date, grace period, lapsed-entitlement policy

scenario: A reply on a ticket bounces with a 'no longer with the company' auto-response; the agent marks the contact inactive in HubSpot, reassigns their open tickets to the account's backup contact, and alerts the CSM that a key contact has left.
rule_hooks: contact role hierarchy, backup contact designation

scenario: A requester asks to add a colleague to their ticket; the agent checks whether the colleague is on the account's authorized-contacts list, adds them as a CC if so, or asks an account admin for approval if not.

A customer asks to waive a late-payment fee on their invoice; the agent checks their payment history in Xero and the waiver policy, removes the fee if they qualify and records the waiver in the ticket, and replies.

The open-ticket count in a queue crosses the backlog threshold in the support dashboard sheet; the agent posts the backlog and oldest-ticket ages to the team-leads Slack channel, opens an overtime sign-up thread, and logs the event in the weekly ops report.
rule_hooks: queue backlog thresholds, overtime approval rules

scenario: A ticket's root cause is traced to a third-party integration partner; the agent files the case through the vendor's support email with the required details, links the vendor case number on the ticket, sets the ticket to on-hold, and updates the customer.
rule_hooks: vendor contact directory, vendor SLA terms

scenario: A new knowledge-base article is published in English; the agent creates translation tasks in the project tool for each supported locale with due dates, and notifies the localization team in Slack.
rule_hooks: supported-locale list, translation turnaround by article priority

scenario: A customer writes into support asking to stop all marketing emails and texts; the agent unsubscribes them from marketing lists in HubSpot while keeping transactional email active, adds an opt-out note to the CRM, and confirms by reply.
rule_hooks: consent categories, transactional vs marketing distinction

scenario: A customer reports their delivered product is missing a component; the agent checks the bill of materials for the SKU, creates a no-charge parts order for the missing item, and sends the customer the tracking details.
rule_hooks: SKU bill of materials, free-parts eligibility window

scenario: A customer asks to receive statements and support replies in an accessible format; the agent records the accommodation in their CRM profile, tags their helpdesk profile so future tickets route to trained agents, and confirms with the customer.
